title: Ecosystem Integrations
content:
**Integrations** are the nervous system of the Gravito Galaxy. Our zero-shim architecture allows you to plug into any major 3rd-party platform—from GraphQL Yoga to Stripe—with zero abstraction penalty.

The Integration Ecosystem

Leverage official orbits or standard npm packages directly. Gravito doesn't lock you in; it powers your choices with native Bun performance.

PROTOCOL_NATIVE

Direct support for GraphQL, gRPC, and REST. No middleman, just raw execution.

ENTERPRISE_READY

Official modules for Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and Enterprise-grade Job Queues.

NPM_COMPAT

100% compatibility with standard NPM packages. If it works in Bun, it works in Gravito.

GraphQL Integration (Yoga)

For high-performance GraphQL endpoints, we recommend using GraphQL Yoga. Its native Fetch-based API maps perfectly to Photon's request cycle.

import { createYoga } from 'graphql-yoga'
import { createSchema } from 'graphql'

const schema = createSchema({
  typeDefs: `type Query { hello: String }`,
  resolvers: { Query: { hello: () => 'Hello from Gravito!' } }
})

const yoga = createYoga({ schema })

// Mount GraphQL directly into the execution path
app.all('/graphql', (c) => yoga.fetch(c.req.raw))

Job Queues (@gravito/stream)

Our high-performance queue system. Scale background tasks independently using multiple drivers (Redis, Database, or In-Memory).

import { OrbitStream, Job } from '@gravito/stream'

// 1. Install Orbit
core.install(new OrbitStream({
  default: 'redis',
  connections: { redis: { driver: 'redis', host: 'localhost' } }
}))

// 2. Define Atomic Job
class EmailJob extends Job {
  constructor(private userId: number) { super() }
  async handle() { /* Business Logic */ }
}

// 3. Dispatch from Logic
app.post('/api/notify', async (c) => {
  await c.get('queue').push(new EmailJob(123))
  return c.json({ queued: true })
})

API Specs & Observability

ASTRAL_OPENAPI

Automated OpenAPI generation via Shadow Contracts.

core.install(new OrbitAstral({
  title: 'Service API',
  contracts: [UserContract]
}))

MONITOR_TELEMETRY

OpenTelemetry, Metrics, and Health check integration.

core.install(new MonitorOrbit({
  tracing: { enabled: true },
  metrics: { path: '/metrics' }
}))

Database & Storage Matrix

Unified access for structured and unstructured data across any cloud provider.

CategoryRecommended ModuleImplementation
SQL`@gravito/atlas`Active Record, Migrations
NoSQL`Atlas MongoDB Driver`Fluent Query Builder
Cache`@gravito/plasma`Redis / In-Memory
Email`@gravito/signal`SMTP, SES, Postmark

Payment Processing (Stripe)

import Stripe from 'stripe'
const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!)

app.post('/api/checkout', async (c) => {
  const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
    payment_method_types: ['card'],
    line_items: [{ price_data: { ... }, quantity: 1 }],
    mode: 'payment',
    success_url: '.../success'
  })
  return c.json({ sessionId: session.id })
})

Architecture: Best Practices

✓ SECURE_SECRETS

Use environment variables for all API keys. Never hardcode sensitive integration logic.

✓ FAIL_FAST

Wrap external calls in strict error handlers to prevent integration stalling from affecting core logic.

**Architect's Insight:** No app is an island. We prioritized
compatibility so you can leverage the billions of hours put into the Node/Bun ecosystem without the friction of proprietary wrappers.
